name: clamav
description: ClamAV antivirus: clamd (local socket), signature updates, daily scans

files.content:
# Managed by `ziroctl module enable clamav` (local socket only: no network listener).
LogFile /var/log/clamav/clamd.log
LogTime yes
LogFileMaxSize 20M
LogRotate yes
PidFile /run/clamav/clamd.pid
LocalSocket /run/clamav/clamd.sock
LocalSocketGroup clamav
LocalSocketMode 660
FixStaleSocket yes
User clamav
Foreground yes
DatabaseDirectory /var/lib/clamav
# Temp files outside /tmp, so clamav-onaccess can watch /tmp
TemporaryDirectory /var/lib/clamav/tmp
# Memory: one signature database in RAM (~1 GB). The default concurrent reload loads a second
# copy during every update; reload in place instead (scans wait ~20 s).
ConcurrentDatabaseReload no
MaxThreads 2
MaxQueue 50
IdleTimeout 30
MaxScanSize 150M
MaxFileSize 50M
StreamMaxLength 50M
MaxRecursion 16
MaxFiles 10000
ExcludePath ^/proc/
ExcludePath ^/sys/
ExcludePath ^/dev/
ExcludePath ^/run/
ExtendedDetectionInfo yes

# Managed by `ziroctl module enable clamav`.
DatabaseDirectory /var/lib/clamav
UpdateLogFile /var/log/clamav/freshclam.log
LogTime yes
LogFileMaxSize 20M
LogRotate yes
PidFile /run/clamav/freshclam.pid
DatabaseOwner clamav
DatabaseMirror database.clamav.net
ScriptedUpdates yes
NotifyClamd /etc/clamav/clamd.conf
Checks 4
# Don't load a test copy of the new database in freshclam (clamd validates it on reload).
TestDatabases no
Foreground yes
ConnectTimeout 30
ReceiveTimeout 600
